# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** widow  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v4 c2 P4](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** head and front of the enterprise  <sub>[v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is described as a sonsy, kindly, matronly woman. She keeps a watchful eye on everything passing her window and can be seen holding her work-hardened hands while caring for others.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel is a capable, outspoken, and farseeing woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Although officious, opinionated, and given to bossing and nagging others to do right, she possesses a warm, good, and kindly heart. She is deeply devoted to church affairs, strict in her standards of modesty and propriety, and a passionate politician. A shrewd observer of human nature, she believes firmly in foreordination and predestination.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c21 P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for decades with her meek husband Thomas in Lynde's Hollow, keeping close watch over all Avonlea news while managing her household and leading church societies. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel initially voiced blunt criticisms, but she quickly forgave Anne after a sincere apology and grew fond of her. She actively managed local initiatives, took part in the Exhibition where her butter and cheese won prizes, and provided constant advice to Marilla and Matthew. Following a long illness during which Rachel nursed him devotedly, her husband Thomas passed away. Facing financial hardship and the sale of her farm, she accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables, taking up residence in the spare room. At Green Gables, she helped Marilla raise the young twins Davy and Dora, continuing her energetic involvement in church work and continuing to knit quilts for Anne's future family.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c5 P8](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0008), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Married Thomas Lynde at age eighteen  <sub>[v3 c2 P23](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0023)</sub>
- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)</sub>
- Knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts in her earlier home  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- Lived as Marilla Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years without a quarrel  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Went to school with a red-haired girl whose hair darkened to auburn  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>

## Quotes

> There, there, get up, child. Of course I forgive you. I guess I was a little too hard on you, anyway. But I’m such an outspoken person. You just mustn’t mind me, that’s what.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>

> Lawful heart, shall I ever forget that tantrum of hers! When I went home that night I says to Thomas, says I, ‘Mark my words, Thomas, Marilla Cuthbert ‘ll live to rue the step she’s took.’ But I was mistaken and I’m real glad of it.  <sub>[v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)</sub>

> Anne is eighteen; I was married when I was that age. We old folks, Marilla, are too much given to thinking children never grow up, that’s what.  <sub>[v3 c2 P23](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0023)</sub>

> Ruby Gillis is dying of galloping consumption. Everybody knows it except herself and her family. They won’t give in.  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

> I’m going to give Anne two of my cotton warp spreads. She tells me they’re getting to be real fashionable again.  <sub>[v4 c2 P4](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0004)</sub>
